nodes.name: FptResourceKind.java
nodes.summary: Enum defining the kinds of FPT curriculum resources (e.g. materials, sessions) attached to a subject.

nodes.name: StudentSubjectSource.java
nodes.summary: Enum indicating how a student's subject record originated (e.g. declared vs imported from FPT).

nodes.name: StudentSubjectStatus.java
nodes.summary: Enum representing the completion status of a student's subject (e.g. passed, in progress, failed).

nodes.name: FptCurriculumRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for FptCurriculum entities, providing lookups by code, program/cohort, and default curriculum resolution.

nodes.name: FptCurriculumRepository
nodes.summary: JPA repository interface exposing curriculum lookup methods by code, program, cohort, and default flag.

nodes.name: FptCurriculumSubjectRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for FptCurriculumSubject entities, supporting curriculum-scoped subject queries and combo lookups for a student's plan.

nodes.name: FptCurriculumSubjectRepository
nodes.summary: JPA repository interface with queries for curriculum subjects, per-student term filtering, and combo-code retrieval.

nodes.name: FptSubjectCloRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for FptSubjectClo (course learning outcome) entities keyed by subject code.

nodes.name: FptSubjectCloRepository
nodes.summary: JPA repository interface for ordered CLO lookups and bulk deletion by subject code.

nodes.name: FptSubjectRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for FptSubject entities providing ordered listing and code-prefix search.

nodes.name: FptSubjectRepository
nodes.summary: JPA repository interface for subject catalog lookups.

nodes.name: FptSubjectResourceRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for FptSubjectResource entities, including queries for materials pending mirroring to storage.

nodes.name: FptSubjectResourceRepository
nodes.summary: JPA repository interface exposing resource lookups by subject code and mirror-candidate queries used for material mirroring.

nodes.name: FptSubjectSkillRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository linking FPT subjects to skills, used for curriculum-to-skill mapping.

nodes.name: FptSubjectSkillRepository
nodes.summary: JPA repository interface for subject-skill link lookups and bulk deletion by subject code.

nodes.name: StudentFptSubjectRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for a student's declared FPT subjects, keyed by user id.

nodes.name: StudentFptSubjectRepository
nodes.summary: JPA repository interface for retrieving a student's subject enrollments by user id and subject code.

nodes.name: StudentSkillEvidenceRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for StudentSkillEvidence records, filtering by status and detection source.

nodes.name: StudentSkillEvidenceRepository
nodes.summary: JPA repository interface for skill evidence lookups by user id, status set, and detection source prefix.

nodes.name: FptMaterialMirrorService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface for kicking off and polling asynchronous jobs that mirror FPT course materials into internal storage.

nodes.name: FptMaterialMirrorService
nodes.summary: Interface defining start and poll operations for the material mirroring background job.

nodes.name: FptOverlayImportService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface for importing an FPT curriculum overlay JSON document into the curriculum/subject/CLO/resource tables.

nodes.name: FptOverlayImportService
nodes.summary: Interface exposing importOverlay to load curriculum overlay data from a parsed JSON root and reference metadata.

nodes.name: SkillEvidenceService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface for retrieving the career skill catalog and recording skill evidence for a student.

nodes.name: SkillEvidenceService
nodes.summary: Interface defining careerSkillCatalog and recordEvidence operations for the skill-evidence subsystem.

nodes.name: StudentCurriculumService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining the student-facing curriculum operations: fetching curriculum/subject detail, declaring terms, and updating subjects.

nodes.name: StudentCurriculumService
nodes.summary: Interface declaring getCurriculum, getSubjectDetail, applyCurriculumTerm, updateSubjects, and setCurriculum for managing a student's curriculum.

nodes.name: FptMaterialMirrorServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements FptMaterialMirrorService, running a background thread that downloads FPT source materials and uploads them to Supabase storage while tracking job status in memory.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an in-memory ConcurrentHashMap of job statuses and a raw daemon Thread rather than a managed executor, so job state does not survive restarts.

nodes.name: FptMaterialMirrorServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation that spawns a worker thread to mirror course materials from external URLs to Supabase, tracking progress via job status objects.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Worker method executed on a background thread that iterates mirror candidates, downloads each resource, uploads it to storage, and updates job status with a final MirrorSummary.

nodes.name: download
nodes.summary: Downloads the raw bytes of a source material from a given URL via a REST template, enforcing the max file size limit.

nodes.name: objectPath
nodes.summary: Builds a normalized storage object path/filename for a mirrored resource based on its source URL and subject code.

nodes.name: FptOverlayImportServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements FptOverlayImportService, parsing a curriculum overlay JSON tree to upsert the curriculum, subjects, CLOs, resources, and subject-skill links in a single import pass.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of Jackson JsonNode traversal and Lombok builder chains to map overlay JSON fields into JPA entities; parses curriculum code tokens (program/cohort/batch) with a regex.

nodes.name: FptOverlayImportServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation that walks curriculum overlay JSON, upserting FptCurriculum, FptSubject, FptSubjectClo, FptSubjectResource, and FptSubjectSkill records via their repositories.

nodes.name: importOverlay
nodes.summary: Top-level import entry point: upserts the curriculum, then for each subject upserts the subject, its skills, CLOs, and resources, returning an ImportSummary.

nodes.name: upsertCurriculum
nodes.summary: Finds or creates an FptCurriculum by code, deriving program/cohort/batch from the code and optionally marking it default.

nodes.name: importSubjectClos
nodes.summary: Parses and saves the course learning outcomes (CLOs) for a subject from its overlay JSON node.

nodes.name: importSubjectResources
nodes.summary: Parses and saves subject materials and session resources (with source URLs, topics, and CLO refs) from the overlay JSON.

nodes.name: SkillEvidenceServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements SkillEvidenceService, aggregating required skills across career paths and persisting student skill evidence with confidence clamping.

nodes.name: SkillEvidenceServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation providing the career skill catalog and recording/updating StudentSkillEvidence rows from detected sources.

nodes.name: recordEvidence
nodes.summary: Records or updates a StudentSkillEvidence entry for the authenticated student, resolving the skill by name and clamping the confidence score.

nodes.name: careerSkillCatalog
nodes.summary: Builds the catalog of skills required across career paths, used to present evidence-recording options to students.

nodes.name: StudentCurriculumServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements StudentCurriculumService: resolves a student's curriculum and subjects, applies declared terms, updates subject statuses, and syncs passed subjects into skill evidence.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest file in the batch (451 lines); coordinates curriculum resolution, subject-status upserts, and cross-cutting sync into the skill-evidence subsystem within a single service impl.

nodes.name: StudentCurriculumServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation that assembles curriculum/subject detail responses, applies term declarations and subject updates, and syncs evidence from passed subjects for the authenticated student.

nodes.name: getSubjectDetail
nodes.summary: Builds a detailed subject response including CLOs, resources, and skills for a given subject code.

nodes.name: applyCurriculumTerm
nodes.summary: Applies a declared curriculum term for the authenticated student, upserting the relevant subject records.

nodes.name: updateSubjects
nodes.summary: Updates the status/source of a batch of the student's FPT subjects based on the incoming request.

nodes.name: setCurriculum
nodes.summary: Sets the authenticated student's chosen curriculum from the request payload.

nodes.name: resolveCurriculum
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective curriculum for a student, falling back to a derived curriculum when none is explicitly set.

nodes.name: deriveCurriculum
nodes.summary: Derives a default curriculum for a student based on their declared major when no explicit curriculum is set.

nodes.name: syncEvidenceFromPassedSubjects
nodes.summary: Scans a student's passed FPT subjects and generates or updates skill evidence records for the skills those subjects map to.

nodes.name: buildCurriculumResponse
nodes.summary: Assembles the full StudentCurriculumResponse DTO combining curriculum metadata, subject list, and progress details.
